Katrina / team — a few technical clarifications from the runtime side before our preflight:

1) SAML attributes: we can accept nameID (email), givenName, familyName, and a custom claim called 'hf_role' for mapping into Redwood roles. If you need group-to-role mapping, we prefer a group claim (groupNames) over full SCIM-to-role mapping for initial pilot.

2) SCIM provisioning: we need an admin token with create/update/delete on /Users and /Groups for the staging tenant. For production, we recommend scoped SCIM tokens and a short-lived approach (rotate every 30 days).

3) Service accounts: please confirm the exact OAuth scopes you want the accounts to have. Typical scopes we request: inference.read, inference.write (for ingestion), admin.service_accounts.read. We will provide an RBAC mapping doc.

4) IP allowlist: does your egress NAT range include both 52.18.0.0/16 and 3.6.0.0/16? If you have a single egress IP list we'll add it to the management plane ACLs.

5) Test tenant: we will provision a temporary staging tenant for Halcyon once we confirm the SCIM admin creds. That tenant will be accessible only from the approved IP ranges.

I'm pasting the minimal SAML metadata snippet we prefer for faster swaps:

-----BEGIN SAMPLE-----
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.halcyonfin.com">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://idp.halcyonfin.com/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
-----END SAMPLE-----

I'll be on the Nov 28 call to walk through the staging steps.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
